name: Nanjō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nanjō city emblem in green, blue and red: a green ring with a stylised letter N above blue waves, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nanjō, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2006.

features.role: Nanjō city emblem — a green ring with a stylised letter N above blue waves, with a red disc
